source_package_role: Private exact-source design baseline; ZIP CRC passed, 13 direct manifest file hashes matched, the two documented manifest self-reference sentinels were present as designed, and the package SHA-256 is recorded. The public case study exposes outcomes and boundaries, not internal operating text.

public_policy_revision.status: current independent-local-operation, public-evidence, runtime-identity, canonical-entrypoint, and project-local-output language
computer_recognition_allowed_for: local logs, state, and export organization
computer_recognition_prohibited_for: control of another independently running copy

canonical_execution.software_trigger: first-party software with launchers, helpers, automation entrypoints, or a required fixed backend filename
required_outcomes: one short ASCII Windows-safe execution namespace is unique case-insensitively
one stable unversioned project-qualified canonical entrypoint serves people and automation
first-party helpers are namespaced and generic unqualified launcher names are avoided
required fixed legacy or upstream backend names remain behind a thin canonical wrapper
a deliberate rename has migration mapping, an approved alias or forwarding shim when safe, a removal version, and no duplicated logic
version, build, and date remain in metadata and release archives rather than the normal canonical entrypoint

project_local_output.software_trigger: software that creates configuration, logs, state, temporary data, exports, diagnostics, reports, downloads, backups, releases, or support packages
required_outcomes: project root is derived from the canonical launcher or script location rather than caller working directory
generated files stay under project-owned roots by default
temporary work uses same-volume project-local staging, verification, and atomic finalization
Desktop, Documents, Downloads, caller working directory, system temp, drive root, and another project are prohibited as silent fallbacks
external output is explicitly selected or configured, normalized, validated, displayed, and recorded
existing external legacy data is reported and mapped rather than silently moved or deleted

runtime_release_identity.software_trigger: released running software that may load credentials or perform authenticated/live startup
required_outcomes: running version/build agrees with package identity metadata
every package-managed immutable file is present and SHA-256 verified
same-version mixed or unsafe packages block authenticated/live startup
blocked mode retains local status, repair guidance, and redacted support evidence without silent rewrite

validation.control_review: completed internally; itemized controls are outside public scope
validation.scenario_review: completed internally; itemized scenarios are outside public scope

privacy_exclusions: project-specific execution namespaces, aliases, backends, and output-root mappings
runtime logs, diagnostics, state, temporary files, exports, and user output
